question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting anticlockwise at equal distances in the same sequence around a circular table. All are facing the centre of the table. If T is sitting in the west, then who is sitting at the third place to the left of P?
solution:
Given :

1) All are facing the centre of the table. If T is sitting in the west,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae05fbc510e6f32b404726512c179a55e3a080710f8c0c1194ef58974960ed95.png] 

2) Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting **anticlockwise at equal distances in the same sequence around a circular table.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fb2b1563d84b5a330265a09b5761cb867e858227985d1d82ff643ffcaff5441.png] 

∴ Here, 'U' is sitting to the third place to left of 'P'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U".**
